No, that is not true.

EU/EFTA cross-border commuters (known as "frontaliers") are permitted to live anywhere within the EU/EFTA and travel to work in Switzerland. There is no legal requirement for them to return home every day, nor are they restricted to living in specific border zones. They can reside in their home country (or elsewhere within the EU/EFTA) and commute daily or weekly to their workplace in Switzerland.

The primary requirement for cross-border workers is obtaining the appropriate work permit or G permit, which allows them to work in Switzerland while maintaining residency in another member state of the EU/EFTA or Switzerland. Swiss regulations aim to facilitate the free movement of workers between Switzerland and the EU/EFTA, not restrict it to border areas or require daily return journeys.
